capabilities: Browse and edit .rmd/.Rmd files with Obsidian's native markdown editor
Display labeled headers above R code chunks and badges on inline R code
Open the current file in RStudio
Render documents via rmarkdown::render() and open the output
Create new .rmd documents from RStudio's default html_document template
disambiguation: Not an R runtime; it displays RMarkdown files and delegates code execution to RStudio or rmarkdown::render().
extras: Desktop only (uses Node child_process/Electron APIs). Reading and editing work without R installed; RStudio/R/pandoc are needed only for the launch and render commands. README documents render-error troubleshooting and a Pandoc smart-quote parsing limitation.
problem: Obsidian does not recognize .rmd or .Rmd files, so RMarkdown documents cannot be browsed, searched, or edited in the vault without converting them to .md.

relations.evidence: Open in RStudio | Launches RStudio with the current file.
Render document | Runs rmarkdown::render() via Rscript, then opens the generated output

requires.name: R with rmarkdown package and pandoc

summary: RMarkdown (.rmd/.Rmd) reader and editor for Obsidian that displays R chunk headers, inline R badges, and adds RStudio/render commands.
